latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Editor de Video Online skill.

- Edit and export MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM videos up to 500MB entirely online.
- AI video editing with trimming, transitions, background music, and more, powered by cloud GPUs.
- Fast cloud rendering (1–2 minutes per clip), delivering 1080p MP4 downloads.
- Handles uploads, exports, credits balance, and timeline previews directly in chat.
- No install required; just upload your video and describe your edits to get started.
